title: Peas Wet: modeled ₹562/qtl left, Kathua → Palampur
summary: January 2024: reported peas Wet prices at Kathua and Palampur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹562 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 282 same-variety market pairs screened for peas Wet in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Palampur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Palampur (Himachal Pradesh) both reported peas Wet prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹2,650 per quintal. Palampur reported a median ₹3,400 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹875/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹875 per quintal, and Palampur was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 140 km by road
scenes.caption: 140 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹30/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹543 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹357 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Palampur report, the rule selects 23 of 24 modeled shipping days. 23 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹562 per quintal (₹388 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Peas Wet route from Kathua to Palampur was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹56,200, or ₹38,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to peas Wet
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹30/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Peas Wet route from Kathua to Palampur was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹56,200, or ₹38,800 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
